expectedChecks: Hamburger icon toggle animation executes smoothly.

executed.title: Multi-Device Layout & Touch Target Verification
executed.preconditions: Device mode enabled in browser DevTools.
steps: Test page layout at standard breakpoints: Mobile (375px, 414px), Tablet (768px, 1024px), Desktop (1280px, 1920px).
Scroll through the entire page at each breakpoint.
Verify tap targets for buttons and interactive controls on touch screen viewports.
expectedChecks: No horizontal scrollbar exists at any viewport size (no horizontal overflow).
Text scales properly, wraps naturally, and remains readable without overlapping other elements.
Multi-column sections (features, pricing, testimonials) stack logically on smaller viewports.
All clickable elements have a minimum touch target size of 44x44px on mobile/tablet views.

assertions.check: No horizontal scrollbar exists at any viewport size (no horizontal overflow).
